 Advertisement Updated: 6:09 PM EST Nov 3, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Raquel Ciampi Digital Content Manager Three bodies discovered outside Mt. Lebanon, Allegheny County parking garage
 Updated: 6:09 PM EST Nov 3, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Raquel Ciampi Digital Content Manager MOUNT LEBANON MUNICIPALITY, Pa. — Police confirm they are at a scene where three bodies were discovered outside a parking garage in Allegheny County Tuesday.
 Police will hold a press conference around 6:15 p.m. That will be held live in the video player above when it becomes available. 
 Advertisement 
 Multiple police departments, fire and emergency medical services are responding to the 700 block of Washington County Road in Mount Lebanon. 
 According to officials, there are three bodies at that location, but authorities could not provide any further information. 
 The Allegheny County Police Department has been called to assist at the scene. 
 VIDEO BELOW: Scene outside the parking garage 
 Officials say there is no danger to the public. 
 This story is developing. Check back with WTAE for the latest updates.
